purpose: Define the boundary from a FreeMarket match/publication into explicit Project participation/assignment relations, ensuring that ranking or discovery never silently creates a work agreement.

owns: Project Assignment and Agreement Boundary semantics

topics.name: Project Assignment and Agreement Boundary
topics.purpose: Define the boundary from a FreeMarket match/publication into explicit Project participation/assignment relations, ensuring that ranking or discovery never silently creates a work agreement.

semantics.assignment_rule: Assignment/participation is an explicit Project relation or operation.
semantics.identity_rule: Assigned parties resolve by exact IdentityCore identities.
semantics.agreement_rule: Any contractual/agreement semantics required by the Project are explicit Project/domain relations rather than inferred from acceptance UI alone.
semantics.authority_rule: Assignment does not grant unrelated AccessCore authority.
semantics.merit_rule: Assignment itself does not create merit; actual accepted Project evidence does.

invariants.rule: FreeMarket/Broker matching and ranking operate over explicit Project, identity, PortfolioCore and MeritCore semantics without creating duplicate work, identity or merit authority.

hard_gates.condition: UI click creates hidden unmodeled agreement semantics

references.purpose: Assignment creates explicit Project participation/role relations.
Merit requires actual accepted work evidence.
